findings.issue: PharmacySwitcher stores selection but doesn't filter any view. selectedPharmacyId is persisted to localStorage and provided by context, but no component reads it to filter API calls or UI. The switcher dropdown changes state without changing what the user sees.
findings.suggestion: Either wire selectedPharmacyId to backend endpoints that accept pharmacy_id parameter, or add a visual indicator (e.g., disabled state or tooltip) clarifying that filtering is not yet functional.

findings.issue: Password field in StaffForm uses autoComplete="new-password" unconditionally. On edit mode (when password is optional), this may cause browsers to incorrectly prompt to save a blank password or suggest a new password when the user only wanted to change other fields.
findings.suggestion: Make autocomplete conditional: autoComplete={f.id ? "off" : "new-password"} or omit it entirely on edit mode.

findings.issue: PharmacyContext logs a warning when user is missing but continues to render with isSystemOwner=false and empty pharmacyList. Downstream consumers of usePharmacy() have no way to distinguish 'not a system owner' from 'context failed to initialize'.
findings.suggestion: Consider exposing an error or loading field from the context to signal initialization failure, or return early with a fallback provider state when user is undefined.
